sentences.text:
.....Petition  Through: Counsel for petitioners (appear  not given)
 versus  THE STATE NCT OF DELHI AND ANR .....Responden  Through: Mr. Ritesh Kumar Bahri, APP f  State with Ms. Divya Yadav,
 Advocate with W/SI Neelu, PS  Dwarka North  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 10.07.2025 [Physical Hearing/Hybrid Hearing (as per request)] CRL.M.A. 12993/2025 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Petitioners seek quashing of FIR No. 315/2015 of PS Dwarka North for offence under Section 406/419/420/464/467/468/471/474/120B/ 34 IPC.
The quashing is sought on the ground that the petitioners (accused persons) have compromised the disputes with respondent no. 2 (father of the victim).
The victim, admittedly not a minor in age, has not been impleaded.
3. Learned APP accepts notice and submits that State has strong objection to this quashing because the allegations against the petitioners also include forgery of government documents.
In other words, the offence involved in this case is not a personal wrong between two parties.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 10/07/2025 at 22:13:05 4.
As requested by learned APP, Status Report be filed within four weeks.

5. Relist on 17.10.2025.
GIRISH KATHPALIA, J JULY 10, 2025/as This is a digitally signed order.
